stable.releaseNotes: Removes the local owner-editing designation requirement. A connected dashboard folder can edit when the browser has read/write access. Removes owner recovery controls and keeps existing file, update, revision, and workspace protections. No workspace migration.

beta.releaseNotes: Respect completed RO reviews until their saved follow-up date unless priority escalates. Source refreshes do not re-request already planned work. No Workspace migration.
